Process_Text.original: ME3 was hot compacted, extruded, and isothermally forged into a flat pancake. They were then supersolvus solution heat treated at 1171 °C using the same fixture and air cooled at the same average rate of approximately 72°C/ min. ME3 was aging heat treated at 843°C for 4h plus 760°C for 8h.
Process_Text.simplified: Hot compaction, extrusion, isothermal forging. Solution treated at 1171°C, air cooled. Aging: 843°C/4h + 760°C/8h.

Microstructure_Text.original: From the EBSD scans the average grain diameter was calculated to be 59.2 μm in ME3. The precipitate microstructures between the two alloys are quite similar. In fact, the final volume fraction (VF) measurements between the two alloys fall within the measurement error. The total γ' volume fraction was 46.61% with an average secondary γ' size of 135 nm and tertiary γ' size of 15.4 nm.
Microstructure_Text.simplified: Average grain diameter 59.2um. Total γ' VF 46.61%, secondary size 135nm, tertiary size 15.4nm.

They were then supersolvus solution heat treated at 1171 °C using the same fixture and air cooled at the same average rate of approximately 72°C/ min. LSHR was aging heat treated at 855°C for 4h plus 775°C for 8h.
